what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Belarus in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2576 Belarusian asylum seekers in the United States, 31.7% of all asylum seekers from Belarus.
Refugees from Belarus, a separate group, live mostly in Poland, the United States, Germany and France.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Belarus, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 112 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 7467, at the end of 2024, and was much lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
